sec: sec:D003: Restrict unsafe tool calls / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:D003: Restrict unsafe tool calls / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Implementing tool call validation and authorization. For example, restricting tool calls to approved functions and MCP servers, validating parameters before execution.
